newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Grain Elevators up on growth pospects.
newsitem.headline: Grain Elevators up on growth pospects.

text.p: Ceylon Grain Elevators Ltd rose 11.4 percent or 1.25 rupees to 12.25 on local and foreign buying, brokers said.
"The stock is expected to perform well in 1997, because high world grain prices which hit profits badly in 1996, are already falling," said a local broker.
The company, which mills feed and produces day-old chicks, showed a loss of 52.7 million rupees for the nine months to September 30, from a profit of 130.8 million in the same period in 1995.
